Appearance.description: Appearance observed at a particular placement; equal block states may have different models.

components.description: Empty for a primal aspect; otherwise the two components used by the game, including repeats.

discovered.description: Observed player knowledge; null when its client cache has not arrived.

frames.description: Empty means a still image; otherwise every frame specifies its crop and tick duration.

Block.description: Actual block state observed in an isolated construction preview, including unmodified tile NBT.

Build.description: A whole construction preview, not a claim that every runtime machine condition passes.

origin.description: Dummy-world coordinate of local [0, 0, 0]; never a player-world position.

rendered.description: False when appearance capture was not requested (the data profile).

result.description: The survival constructor's final result; creative construction has no return code.

size.description: Coordinates are east, down, north, with the controller facing south.

index.description: Index into the declaring piece's rules or the build's block palette.

samples.description: One native result per input choice, in matching order; excluded from recipe identity.

amount.description: Positive signed-64-bit integer: item count or fluid millibuckets.

Circuit.description: A circuit family or component family defined by the game's diagram provider. Adjacent steps describe progression, not a fabricated crafting recipe.

amount.description: Relative component count from the material definition, not a recipe quantity.

oneOf.description: Copy the input item, metadata, count and tags. Replace root tags, then cap numeric tags using Minecraft getInteger semantics (missing/non-numeric = 0).
TC4Tweaks inheritance: output scalars win, compounds merge and equal-type lists append. An untagged base instead inherits input metadata/count and the entire input compound.

keys.description: None copies all root keys. A nonempty list filters only the root merge.

tools.description: Both input and base must be armor or have at least one native tool class.

index.description: Index into the owning recipe's magic aspect costs, never an inventory item.

terms.description: Precomputed search text includes registry, display name, tooltip, ore tags and pinyin.

knowledge.description: Digests of knowledge states used by adapters; no player names or world locations.

probes.description: Construction parameters, ordered by count then channel name/value pairs.

resources.description: Selected resource packs, in the game's priority order.

vertices.description: Original winding; triangles repeat their third vertex in the fourth position.

registry.description: The actual global Forge fluid key, which need not contain a namespace.

Gene.description: A populated chromosome of a registered template, not a player's individual genome.

value.description: An API-provided scalar or vector. Providers with executable behavior have no invented value.

Grid.description: Crafting arrangement is recipe data and remains available when no view is captured.

cells.description: Row-major item input slot references, with explicit empty cells.

armor.description: Actual ItemArmor classification; durability alone does not identify armor or tools.

aspects.description: Thaumcraft's returned object tags; null means it provided no value, not zero aspects.

name.description: Reference to a localized, Minecraft-formatted string.

order.description: NEI order; null denotes an item discovered only through a recipe.

tags.description: Exact OreDictionary membership reported by the game.

Lineage.description: Mutation adjacency, so one species page never decodes the entire breeding graph.

MagicRecipe.description: Registered recipe costs before equipment discounts and observed research prerequisites.

aspects.description: Vis for arcane crafting; essentia for crucible and infusion recipes.

central.description: Item input slot containing the central infusion ingredient.

creative.description: The configured creative-mode waiver bypasses Vis checks/consumption. An empty arcane cost list is usable only with this waiver, not free in survival.

instability.description: Base infusion instability, independent of the player's altar and stabilizers.

payment.description: Optional Salis self-payment. Ordinary arcane output samples assume a separate wand in the workbench's supply slot; this mode requires it empty.

oneOf.description: Compare only the named root tags with the choice; other tags are allowed. Presence checks ignore the tag's type and value, including false/zero.

color.description: ARGB color reported by the registry.

formula.description: The source's formula verbatim; not parsed or guessed from an item tooltip.

content.description: Material units in one item; null when the source does not define a conversion.

key.description: Registry form, e.g. plate, wireGt01, molten. It is not inferred from a name.

form.description: Actual item form, e.g. queen, drone, sapling, pollen.

Model.description: Native tessellated faces. Texture coordinates refer to one source sprite, not its packed atlas.

hidden.description: Explicit native suppression (for example the second block of a double chest), never a failed capture.

Motion.description: A discrete native UI state. Areas reveal matching fractions of the texture and destination.

areas.description: Non-overlapping [left, top, right, bottom] rectangles in [0,1], as finite float32 decimal strings. An empty list hides the element for this state.

chance.description: Unmodified base rate in 0..1; housing, mode, research and world conditions are not applied.

conditions.description: Localized descriptions from the provider, not executable eligibility rules.

genes.description: The mutation's actual result template can differ from the species' registered default.

handler.description: Actual implementation class; conditions remain descriptive, not executable rules.

id.description: Content identity: Forestry exposes no mutation registry key.

occurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence among identical registrations, retaining independent attempts.

parents.description: An unordered pair, canonically sorted. Self-crosses retain two equal entries.

change.description: With a change, id/amount are the first input choice's example, not a fixed result.

Payment.description: The consumed input pays the arcane cost using its OLD components and the player's equipment discount. After payment, the new wand retains the remaining charge up to capacity, or zeros these tags. No fixed paid-output sample is implied.

charges.description: Primal aspect id -> root NBT charge key. Charge/capacity are hundredths of Vis.

size.description: Local A/B/C coordinates: right, down, depth. Pieces have no inferred assembly transform.

chance.description: Bee base rate per production cycle. Tree product lists supply no probability: null.

Ratio.description: An exact amount of base material, independent of item counts or fluid volume.

duration.description: Ticks, when the source defines a duration.

energy.description: Signed EU/t; negative values denote generation.

properties.description: Namespaced properties with an explicit value type and unit.

RecipeIndex.description: Compact recipe metadata for filtering and counts without decoding full ingredient payloads.

Research.description: Research prerequisites and observed knowledge, not a claim that the player can currently unlock it.

id.description: Null is permitted only for an unregistered @ knowledge flag, as defined by Thaumcraft.

placements.description: Advisory getBlocksToPlace results, never an exhaustive legality predicate or bill of materials. Null means the provider does not enumerate placement stacks.

Shape.description: Bounded geometry records keep large definitions out of a single source row or HTTP response.

fruitCompatible.description: Whether the tree species supports its default template's fruit family.

nocturnal.description: Natural bee activity; distinct from the template's nocturnal tolerance chromosome.

source.description: The root UID is the handler; the species allele UID is the key.

temperature.description: Native climate symbols from Forestry, not guessed biome or numeric ranges.

Structure.description: A StructureLib definition, not a claim that one assembled machine passes its world checks.

probe.description: First requested parameter set, used for definition placement hints.

problem.description: An explicit missing definition is allowed only in a selection snapshot.

voltage.description: Nominal voltage in EU per packet.

image.description: A standalone atlas image when this topic has no item/fluid icon.

Track.description: Shared clipping timeline, independent of the texture or recipe using it.

frames.description: One repeating native UI cycle, compressed by consecutive equal states; never recipe duration.

Variant.description: Exactly one outcome for a requested construction parameter set.

at.description: Finite float32 decimal strings in local east/down/north block coordinates. Strings preserve the game's decimal representation across Java, Rust and JavaScript identities.

color.description: Native per-vertex tint and shading, in unsigned RRGGBBAA byte order.

uv.description: Finite float32 decimal strings in the sprite's [0,1] range, top row at v=0.

description: Owns the schema exported to consumers; it is not a runtime payload itself.
title: Contract
